probes.procedure: Use node1's protected client environment without printing values. Verify initialized/unsealed production Vault, database/ mount, pg-main, infraset-app with 30s default/60s max TTL, and PostgreSQL infraset. Issue two distinct dynamic credentials and prove each can select/insert/update/delete only evaluator rows in public.credential_probe over hostname-validating TLS.
probes.cleanup: Delete evaluator rows, revoke every issued lease still active, and verify evaluator-created PostgreSQL roles are removed.

probes.procedure: Issue two fresh leases. Revoke one exact lease and prove its login promptly stops authenticating; allow the other to expire past its returned TTL and prove it stops authenticating without operator action. Then issue a fresh credential and prove declared DML still works.
probes.cleanup: Revoke remaining evaluator leases, delete evaluator rows, and confirm generated evaluator logins no longer authenticate.

probes.procedure: Inspect failed/duplicate/dev Vault or PostgreSQL services, stale dynamic roles after lease cleanup, plaintext credentials in arguments/files, temporary responses, abandoned installers, extra listeners/openings, and conflicting configuration.

assertions.pass_condition: Vault is production initialized/unsealed with database/, pg-main, and infraset-app configured for exactly 30s default and 60s maximum leases.
assertions.fail_condition: Authenticated live state confirms Vault unavailable/dev/sealed, missing engine/connection/role, or incorrect lease TTLs.

assertions.pass_condition: Two distinct returned credentials authenticate over PostgreSQL TLS and perform only declared DML on public.credential_probe.
assertions.fail_condition: Healthy Vault/PostgreSQL prerequisites confirm credentials not unique, cannot perform required DML, or have broader proven database capability.

assertions.pass_condition: Revoking an exact returned lease promptly prevents its PostgreSQL login while fresh issuance continues working.
assertions.fail_condition: The revoked login remains able to authenticate after confirmed successful revocation.

assertions.pass_condition: A lease allowed past its returned TTL stops authenticating automatically while fresh issuance still works.
assertions.fail_condition: The expired login remains able to authenticate after sufficient TTL allowance.

assertions.pass_condition: Only required production Vault, PostgreSQL, data, PKI, audit, protected credential, and operational state remains with no stale evaluator roles.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete failed, dev, duplicate, stale-role, secret-bearing, temporary, broad, or abandoned executor state remains.
